verses.verse:
भागत्रयम् प्रपूयैंर्व फूतकारो यत्र साध्यते।
अतस्ताम् त्रिपुराम् बंशीम् कथयन्ति मनीषिणः।७१।
verses.text: Where the blowing is accomplished by covering three parts [of the opening], the wise therefore call that bānsurī the Tripurā.

commentary.text: Some practitioners blow the bānsurī two or four times, fail, and lose heart; so an effort is being made to awaken their enthusiasm again.

subsection.title: Practice of the Tongue and of the Fingers
